description: Acquires the public CMS NPPES monthly V2 replacement and normalizes organization NPIs, reported U.S. practice locations, taxonomies, and organization other names with strict status and export semantics.
retry: Retain the deterministic partial archive and resume with a validated HTTP Range request; restart if the provider does not honor the range or the archive is invalid.
checkpoint: A source lock records PID ownership, dead owners are recovered, source files are checksummed, and all release artifacts remain run-scoped until atomic publication.
idempotency: The CMS release filename identifies the source snapshot; NPI and normalized address hashes determine stable source-record and entity-candidate IDs.
cancellation: Abort the active request or stream, retain a valid partial download for resume, and do not change a current dataset pointer before quality-gated publication.
retention_profile: Retain immutable source snapshots internally and public normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
